sourceMetadata.name: Living adult Asian woman head
sourceMetadata.origin: Upper neck at head attachment, between the back of the jaw and occipital base; y=0 at source y=4.88
sourceMetadata.uv: MakeHuman hm08 body atlas, barycentrically transferred after decimation; separate normal attribute smooths UV seams
sourceMetadata.construction: Base plus asian-female-young target at weight 1. Skin clipped at upper neck. Original neutral eyelids, lips, nose, jaw and ears retained; open eye sockets require included eyes. No ghost deformation. Hair, brows, iris color and clothes excluded.

metadata.construction: Weld coincident source vertices. Taper lower source neck to existing attachment. Harmonic local oral regularisation and monotone analytic jaw-stretch deltas; upper skull/lids/nose fixed. Bake triangle-ray forehead and scalp envelopes with seam-safe samples and four smoothing passes. Excise local oral ellipse (x/.035)^2+((y-.032)/.012)^2<1,z>.095; discard disconnected sealed internal mouth shell. Keep full anatomical skull, lids, nose, ears and jaw. Stitch original 32-vertex oral boundary to 64-vertex lip with 8 rings and zipper triangles. Separate source eye meshes retained.
